docker.Rmd

Docker

The synapser package has low level dependencies like openssl, zlib and the development version of curl. These are usually provided in linux installations but if you are using the r-base Docker image (https://hub.docker.com/_/r-base/) they are not included. The following Dockerfile ensures the required dependencies are in place and also installs synapser.

FROM r-base
RUN rm /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/default
RUN apt-get update -y
RUN apt-get install -y dpkg-dev zlib1g-dev libssl-dev libffi-dev
RUN apt-get install -y curl libcurl4-openssl-dev
RUN R -e "install.packages('synapser', repos=c('http://ran.synapse.org', 'https://cloud.r-project.org'))"
